# Krao lexicons (`net.krao.*`)

<!-- Generated by scripts/krao-lexicon-docs.mjs from lexicons/net/krao. Do not edit by hand: run the script. -->

Krao's records, XRPC methods and OAuth permission sets. Methods are served by Krao's services:
the indexer (most `net.krao.*` queries, wallet previews, Mini Apps), the rewards service
(`account`, `kyc`, `phone`, `points`, `referral`, `rewards`, `analytics`, `push`) and the PDS
(`server`). Methods marked as needing service auth take a token from the user's PDS
(`com.atproto.server.getServiceAuth`, audience the service DID, `lxm` the method).
Mini App developers: see [miniapps.md](./miniapps.md).

## net.krao.account

<a id="netkraoaccountdefs"></a>

<a id="netkraoaccountdefs-consentview"></a>

### `net.krao.account.defs#consentView`

Type: **object**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | string | yes |  |
| `items` | string (`terms`, `privacy`, `kyc`, `phone`, `wallet`)[] | yes |  |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoaccountexportdata"></a>

### `net.krao.account.exportData`

Type: **query**

Everything this Krao service holds about the viewer, as JSON. Each Krao service that keeps personal data answers it (rewards, indexer, chat); call each with service auth addressed to it. The rewards service includes what the push service holds.

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `service` | string (`rewards`, `indexer`, `chat`) | yes | Which service answered. |
| `did` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `exportedAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |
| `data` | unknown | yes | The service's data, by kind. Its shape is the service's own. |

<a id="netkraoaccountgetconsent"></a>

### `net.krao.account.getConsent`

Type: **query**

The viewer's consent records, newest first. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `consents` | [`net.krao.account.defs#consentView`](#netkraoaccountdefs-consentview)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoaccountrecordconsent"></a>

### `net.krao.account.recordConsent`

Type: **procedure**

Record that the viewer agreed to a version of Krao's terms and to the processing of the listed kinds of personal data. Each call adds a record; earlier ones are kept. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | string | yes | Version of the terms and privacy policy shown, eg 2026-10-16. |
| `items` | string (`terms`, `privacy`, `kyc`, `phone`, `wallet`)[] | yes | What the viewer agreed to. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.account.defs#consentView`](#netkraoaccountdefs-consentview)

<a id="netkraoactordefs-primarynameview"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.defs#primaryNameView`

Type: **object**

A verified Basename or ENS name of one of the account's verified wallets: the wallet's reverse record names it, and the name resolves to the same address. At most one per account, Basenames first.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | Lowercase ASCII name, eg alice.base.eth. |
| `source` | string (`basename`, `ens`) | yes |  |
| `address` | string | yes | The wallet address (lowercase 0x hex) the name belongs to. |

<a id="netkraoactordefs-onchainwalletview"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.defs#onchainWalletView`

Type: **object**

A verified wallet the account owns (no other account linked it first).

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | string | yes | CAIP-2 chain id of the link, eg 'eip155:8453'. |
| `address` | string | yes | The address as linked (lowercase 0x hex for EVM wallets). |
| `label` | string (≤ 64 graphemes) |  |  |

<a id="netkraoactordefs-onchainnftview"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.defs#onchainNftView`

Type: **object**

NFTs the account's owned wallets hold. Enumerable ERC-721 collections list one item per token; others one item per collection with the balance. The verified NFT avatar is always listed, with isAvatar.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | string | yes |  |
| `contract` | string | yes | Lowercase contract address. |
| `tokenId` | string |  | Decimal token id, when the item is one token. |
| `balance` | string | yes | How many the wallets hold, decimal ('1' for a single token). |
| `collectionName` | string |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `image` | string (uri) |  | The token's image through Krao's NFT image proxy (never a third-party host). |
| `isAvatar` | boolean | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoactordefs-supportsummaryview"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.defs#supportSummaryView`

Type: **object**

Totals of verified public support: tips (anonymous ones left out) and active memberships. USD at current catalog prices, USDC as one dollar.

| `tipsSentUsd` | string | yes |  |

| `tipsSent` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `tipsReceived` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `membershipsActive` | integer (≥ 0) | yes | Creators the account is an active member of. |
| `membersActive` | integer (≥ 0) | yes | Active members of the account (as a creator). |

<a id="netkraoactorgetchainprofiles"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.getChainProfiles`

Type: **query**

Get web3 details (linked wallets, NFT avatar, tip count) for several accounts. Accounts without web3 data are omitted.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actors` | string (at-identifier)[] | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `profiles` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#chainProfileView`](#netkraoactordefs-chainprofileview)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoactorgetonchainprofile"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.getOnchainProfile`

Type: **query**

An account's on-chain profile tab: its verified Basename/ENS name, the verified wallets it owns, NFTs those wallets hold (from Krao's approved collections, plus its verified NFT avatar; read on-chain, cached for minutes) and totals of its verified public support (anonymous tips are left out). Public. NotFound for accounts that are taken down or deactivated.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actor` | string (at-identifier) | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `primaryName` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#primaryNameView`](#netkraoactordefs-primarynameview) |  |  |
| `wallets` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#onchainWalletView`](#netkraoactordefs-onchainwalletview)[] | yes |  |
| `nfts` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#onchainNftView`](#netkraoactordefs-onchainnftview)[] | yes |  |
| `support` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#supportSummaryView`](#netkraoactordefs-supportsummaryview) | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`

<a id="netkraoactorgetsupporthistory"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.getSupportHistory`

Type: **query**

An account's verified tips and membership payments, sent or received, the newest first. Tips marked anonymous are left out in both directions. Public. NotFound for accounts that are taken down or deactivated.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actor` | string (at-identifier) | yes |  |
| `direction` | string (`sent`, `received`) | yes |  |
| `limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 50, default 25) |  |  |
| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | [`net.krao.actor.defs#supportItemView`](#netkraoactordefs-supportitemview)[] | yes |  |
| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`

<a id="netkraoactornftavatar"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.nftAvatar`

Type: **record** (record key: `literal:self`)

Declares that the account's profile avatar is an NFT it owns. The AppView shows it as verified only while a wallet linked via net.krao.actor.wallet holds the token.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nft` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#nftRef`](#netkraochaindefs-nftref) | yes |  |
| `wallet` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`](#netkraochaindefs-accountid) | yes | The linked wallet that holds the NFT. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoactorresolvenft"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.resolveNft`

Type: **query**

Look up an NFT on-chain: its current owner, collection name and image from its token metadata. Served by the Krao indexer.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | string | yes | CAIP-2 chain id, eg eip155:8453. |
| `contract` | string | yes |  |
| `tokenId` | string | yes |  |
| `owner` | string |  | For ERC-1155, the address to check the balance of. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nft` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#nftRef`](#netkraochaindefs-nftref) | yes |  |
| `owner` | string |  | ERC-721 owner address. |
| `ownedByQueried` | boolean |  | For ERC-1155, whether the queried owner holds the token. |
| `collectionName` | string |  |  |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `image` | string (uri) |  |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`: The contract or token does not exist on that chain.
- `UnsupportedChain`

<a id="netkraoactorwallet"></a>

### `net.krao.actor.wallet`

Type: **record** (record key: `tid`)

Links a blockchain wallet to the account. The proof lets anyone verify the wallet owner agreed to the link. An account may link many wallets.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`](#netkraochaindefs-accountid) | yes |  |
| `proof` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#walletProof`](#netkraochaindefs-walletproof) | yes |  |
| `label` | string (≤ 64 graphemes) |  | Optional user-chosen name for the wallet. |
| `showPrimaryName` | boolean |  | Whether the wallet's verified Basename/ENS name may be shown next to the handle. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

### `net.krao.admin.getMyRoles`

Type: **query**

The viewer's Krao admin roles, from the services' configuration and from admins (`admin` comes with every other role). Empty for most accounts. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `roles` | [`net.krao.admin.defs#role`](#netkraoadmindefs-role)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoadminlistroles"></a>

### `net.krao.admin.listRoles`

Type: **query**

Every account with a Krao admin role, and where each role comes from. Admins only (service auth for the rewards service).

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `members` | [`net.krao.admin.defs#member`](#netkraoadmindefs-member)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoadminsetrole"></a>

### `net.krao.admin.setRole`

Type: **procedure**

Grant or remove a Krao admin role, logged. Roles from the configuration cannot be removed, and admins cannot remove their own `admin` role. Takes effect at the indexer within a minute. Admins only (service auth for the rewards service).

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `role` | [`net.krao.admin.defs#role`](#netkraoadmindefs-role) | yes |  |
| `enabled` | boolean | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.admin.defs#member`](#netkraoadmindefs-member)

**Errors**

- `UnknownRole`
- `EnvRole`
- `OwnAdminRole`

## net.krao.analytics

### `net.krao.analytics.defs#cohort`

Type: **object**

Accounts created in one week (Monday to Monday, Vietnam time). dN counts those active on day N after the day they were created (d1: day 1; d7: days 6-8; d30: days 28-32); absent until every account of the cohort is past the window.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `week` | string | yes | The Monday the week starts on, YYYY-MM-DD (Vietnam time). |
| `size` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `d1` | integer (≥ 0) |  |  |
| `d7` | integer (≥ 0) |  |  |
| `d30` | integer (≥ 0) |  |  |

<a id="netkraoanalyticsgetfunnel"></a>

### `net.krao.analytics.getFunnel`

Type: **query**

The sign-up funnel of the accounts created between since and until (default: the last 30 days): how many of them verified a phone, passed KYC, linked a wallet and sent a first verified tip, whenever and in whatever order. Rewards admins only (service auth).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | string (datetime) |  |  |
| `until` | string (datetime) |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | string (datetime) | yes |  |
| `until` | string (datetime) | yes |  |
| `steps` | [`net.krao.analytics.defs#funnelStep`](#netkraoanalyticsdefs-funnelstep)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoanalyticsgetretention"></a>

### `net.krao.analytics.getRetention`

Type: **query**

Retention by sign-up week: the last `weeks` weeks (Vietnam time), the current one included, the oldest first. Rewards admins only (service auth).

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `weeks` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 26, default 8) |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cohorts` | [`net.krao.analytics.defs#cohort`](#netkraoanalyticsdefs-cohort)[] | yes |  |

<a id="netkraoanalyticsgetsummary"></a>

### `net.krao.analytics.getSummary`

Type: **query**

Headline numbers: accounts (created through sign-up and not taken down or deleted), and accounts active today, in the last 7 and the last 30 days (Vietnam time, today included). Rewards admins only (service auth).

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accounts` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `activeToday` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `active7d` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `active30d` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |
| `posts7d` | integer (≥ 0) |  |  |

## net.krao

<a id="netkraoauthminiapp"></a>

### `net.krao.authMiniApp`

Type: **permission-set**

Title: Krao Mini App

Know who you are on Krao, and vote in polls and send tips as you. Nothing else in your account.

- `repo` (actions: create): `net.krao.poll.vote`, `net.krao.feed.tip`

<a id="netkraoauthweb3"></a>

### `net.krao.authWeb3`

Type: **permission-set**

Title: Krao web3

Manage your linked wallets, NFT avatar, tips, memberships, polls, gated posts, communities and Mini Apps on Krao, and use Krao's wallet and rewards services for you. Not your phone number, identity verification, consents or data export.

- `repo`: `net.krao.actor.wallet`, `net.krao.actor.nftAvatar`, `net.krao.feed.tip`, `net.krao.membership.payment`, `net.krao.membership.plan`, `net.krao.poll.poll`, `net.krao.poll.vote`, `net.krao.gate.rule`, `net.krao.community.profile`, `net.krao.community.membership`, `net.krao.community.moderator`, `net.krao.community.approval`, `net.krao.community.ban`, `net.krao.community.hide`, `net.krao.community.submission`, `net.krao.miniapp.app`
- `rpc` (audience from the `include:` scope): `net.krao.community.getCommunity`, `net.krao.community.getPendingMembers`, `net.krao.community.listMyCommunities`, `net.krao.creator.getStats`, `net.krao.gate.getContent`, `net.krao.gate.putContent`, `net.krao.gate.uploadMedia`, `net.krao.membership.getPlans`, `net.krao.membership.getStatus`, `net.krao.membership.listMembers`, `net.krao.membership.listMyMemberships`, `net.krao.points.getBalance`, `net.krao.points.listEntries`, `net.krao.points.setLeaderboardOptIn`, `net.krao.poll.getPolls`, `net.krao.poll.getResults`, `net.krao.push.setLanguage`, `net.krao.referral.getOverview`, `net.krao.referral.listReferrals`, `net.krao.rewards.getRoles`, `net.krao.wallet.inspectSignature`, `net.krao.wallet.simulate`

## net.krao.chain

<a id="netkraochaindefs"></a>

<a id="netkraochaindefs-chainid"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#chainId`

Type: **string**

CAIP-2 chain ID, eg 'eip155:1' (Ethereum mainnet), 'eip155:8453' (Base) or 'solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp' (Solana mainnet).

Schema: string

<a id="netkraochaindefs-accountid"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`

Type: **string**

CAIP-10 account ID: a chain ID plus an address, eg 'eip155:1:0xab16a96D359eC26a11e2C2b3d8f8B8942d5Bfcdb'.

Schema: string

<a id="netkraochaindefs-assetid"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#assetId`

Type: **string**

CAIP-19 asset ID, eg 'eip155:1/slip44:60' (ETH) or 'eip155:8453/erc20:0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913' (USDC on Base).

Schema: string

<a id="netkraochaindefs-nftref"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#nftRef`

Type: **object**

Reference to a single non-fungible token.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#chainId`](#netkraochaindefs-chainid) | yes |  |
| `contract` | string | yes | Contract address (EVM) or collection/mint address (Solana). |
| `tokenId` | string | yes | Token ID as a decimal string (EVM) or the mint address (Solana). |
| `standard` | string (`erc721`, `erc1155`, `metaplex`) |  |  |

<a id="netkraochaindefs-walletproof"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#walletProof`

Type: **object**

A signature by a wallet over a message that names the account's DID, proving the DID controls the wallet.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | string (`siwe`, `siws`) | yes | Signing scheme. 'siwe' is EIP-4361 (Sign-In With Ethereum), 'siws' is Sign-In With Solana. |
| `message` | string | yes | The exact signed message. It must contain the account DID (as the SIWE/SIWS URI or a resource) so the proof cannot be replayed for another account. |
| `signature` | string | yes | Signature encoded as 0x-prefixed hex (EVM) or base58 (Solana). Smart contract wallets sign with ERC-1271, or ERC-6492 before they are deployed. |

<a id="netkraochaindefs-verificationstatus"></a>

### `net.krao.chain.defs#verificationStatus`

Type: **string**

Result of the AppView checking a claim on-chain.

Schema: string (`verified`, `pending`, `invalid`)

## net.krao.community

Approves a member of a community whose access mode is 'approval'. Counts in the repo of the owner or a current moderator.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `community` | string (at-uri) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraocommunityban"></a>

### `net.krao.community.ban`

Type: **record** (record key: `tid`)

Bans an account from a community: its membership stops counting and its posts leave the feed. Counts in the repo of the owner, or of a current moderator for accounts that are not moderators. Delete the record to lift the ban.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `community` | string (at-uri) | yes |  |
| `subject` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `reason` | string (≤ 300 graphemes) |  |  |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraocommunitydefs"></a>

<a id="netkraocommunitydefs-access"></a>

### `net.krao.community.defs#access`

Type: **object**

Who may join. 'open': anyone; 'approval': the owner or a moderator approves each member; 'condition': the member's linked wallets meet the conditions (checked again from time to time); 'verified': the member verified a phone number or passed KYC with Krao.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | string (`open`, `approval`, `condition`, `verified`) | yes |  |
| `conditions` | [`net.krao.gate.defs#tokenBalance`](#netkraogatedefs-tokenbalance) \\| [`net.krao.gate.defs#nftHolding`](#netkraogatedefs-nftholding) (open)[] |  | For 'condition': the same conditions as token gates. |
| `match` | string (`all`, `any`) |  | Whether all conditions must be met or any one of them. Defaults to 'all'. |

<a id="netkraocommunitydefs-communityview"></a>

### `net.krao.community.defs#communityView`

Type: **object**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uri` | string (at-uri) | yes |  |
| `cid` | string (cid) |  |  |
| `owner` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `slug` | string | yes | The record key of the profile record. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `avatar` | string (cid) |  | CID of the avatar blob in the owner's repo. |
| `rules` | string[] | yes |  |
| `access` | [`net.krao.community.defs#access`](#netkraocommunitydefs-access) | yes |  |
| `chatJoinLink` | string (uri) |  |  |
| `memberCount` | integer | yes | Members in good standing, including the owner and moderators. |
| `moderators` | string (did)[] |  |  |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |
| `indexedAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |
| `feed` | string (at-uri) |  | The community's feed generator (rkey community-<slug> in the owner's repo, served by the indexer), when the owner published one. It lists the community's public posts. |
| `viewer` | [`net.krao.community.defs#viewerState`](#netkraocommunitydefs-viewerstate) |  |  |

<a id="netkraocommunitydefs-viewerstate"></a>

### `net.krao.community.defs#viewerState`

Type: **object**

The viewer's place in the community. 'member': in good standing; 'pending': joined, waiting for approval (or for the first check of the conditions); 'ineligible': joined, but does not meet the conditions or is not verified; 'banned'; 'none': has not joined.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | string (`member`, `pending`, `ineligible`, `banned`, `none`) | yes |  |
| `role` | string (`owner`, `moderator`, `member`) |  |  |
| `eligible` | boolean |  | For 'condition' and 'verified' communities: whether the viewer meets the requirement now (also when they have not joined). |
| `reason` | string |  | Why the viewer is not a member, eg 'NotVerified', 'ConditionsNotMet', 'AwaitingApproval', 'Banned'. |
| `membership` | string (at-uri) |  | The viewer's net.krao.community.membership record, if any. |

### `net.krao.community.defs#memberView`

Type: **object**

<a id="netkraocommunitygetcommunity"></a>

### `net.krao.community.getCommunity`

Type: **query**

A community with its member count. With service auth for the indexer (the gate service DID), also the caller's membership state, checked on-chain or with Krao's verification for 'condition' and 'verified' communities. Without auth, no viewer state. Rate limited.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uri` | string (at-uri) | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `community` | [`net.krao.community.defs#communityView`](#netkraocommunitydefs-communityview) | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`

| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feed` | [`net.krao.community.defs#feedItem`](#netkraocommunitydefs-feeditem)[] | yes |  |
| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`

Members of a community in good standing: the owner and moderators first, then members, the most recent first. Public and rate limited.

<a id="netkraofeedtip"></a>

### `net.krao.feed.tip`

Type: **record** (record key: `tid`)

Records an on-chain tip sent to another account, optionally for a specific post. The transfer itself happens on-chain from the sender's wallet; the AppView only counts the tip after verifying the transaction.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `recipient` | string (did) | yes | The account that received the tip. |
| `subject` | `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` |  | The post being tipped, if any. |
| `asset` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#assetId`](#netkraochaindefs-assetid) | yes |  |
| `amount` | string | yes | Amount in the asset's smallest unit (eg wei), as a decimal integer string. |
| `txHash` | string | yes | Transaction hash (EVM) or signature (Solana) of the transfer, on the chain given by the asset ID. |
| `from` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`](#netkraochaindefs-accountid) |  | The sender's wallet. Should be a wallet linked to the sender's account. |
| `to` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`](#netkraochaindefs-accountid) |  | The recipient's wallet. Must be a wallet linked to the recipient's account. |
| `message` | string (≤ 300 graphemes) |  |  |
| `anonymous` | boolean |  | Count this tip as an anonymous supporter in public supporter lists (net.krao.creator.getTopSupporters). The record itself stays public in the sender's repo. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

| `match` | string (`all`, `any`) |  | Whether the viewer must meet all conditions or any one of them. Defaults to 'all'. |

## net.krao.indexer

<a id="netkraoindexeradminreplayfailedevents"></a>

### `net.krao.indexer.admin.replayFailedEvents`

Type: **procedure**

Index again the firehose events whose handler kept failing (the indexer's failedEvents), oldest first, from the current state of the PDS: records that still exist are indexed, records that are gone are deleted, accounts take their current status. Events that index are removed from the list; others stay with their new error. Indexer admins (the safety admins) only; requires service auth for the indexer.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 1000, default 100) |  | Most events to replay in this call. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `replayed` | integer | yes | Events indexed and removed from the list. |
| `failed` | integer | yes | Events that failed again. |
| `remaining` | integer | yes | Events still in the list, including the ones that failed again. |

| `cursor` | string |  |  |

<a id="netkraomembershippayment"></a>

### `net.krao.membership.payment`

Type: **record** (record key: `tid`)

Records a membership payment: a USDC transfer on Base from a wallet linked to the member (this repo) to a wallet linked to the creator, of at least the plan's price. The indexer checks the transaction; a verified payment makes the member active for 30 days from the transaction's block time, or extends a membership that is still active by 30 days from its current expiry.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plan` | `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` | yes | The creator's net.krao.membership.plan record. |
| `creator` | string (did) | yes | The account offering the plan; the repo of the plan record. |
| `chain` | string (`eip155:8453`) | yes | CAIP-2 chain of the transaction. Only Base ('eip155:8453') is accepted. |
| `txHash` | string | yes | Hash of the transaction holding the USDC transfer. One transaction backs one payment or tip only, and it must be at most 24 hours older than this record. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraomembershipplan"></a>

### `net.krao.membership.plan`

Type: **record** (record key: `tid`)

A monthly membership plan offered by the account (the creator). Members pay the price in USDC on Base straight to a wallet the creator linked; Krao takes no fee and holds no funds. At most 3 plans of an account count as active; the indexer treats further active plans as inactive.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string (≤ 64 graphemes) | yes |  |
| `description` | string (≤ 500 graphemes) |  |  |
| `priceUsdc` | string | yes | Price of 30 days of membership in USDC base units (6 decimals) as a decimal integer string, from 1000000 ($1) to 1000000000 ($1000). |
| `perks` | string (≤ 100 graphemes)[] |  |  |
| `active` | boolean | yes | Whether new members can join or renew. Existing memberships run until they expire. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

## net.krao.miniapp

<a id="netkraominiappadminapprove"></a>

### `net.krao.miniapp.admin.approve`

Type: **procedure**

Approve a Mini App at its current version: `cid` must be the record's current CID, so a change made during review is not approved by mistake. Also lifts a revocation. Safety admins only (logged); requires service auth for the indexer.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `uri` | string (at-uri) | yes |  |

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | [`net.krao.miniapp.defs#miniAppView`](#netkraominiappdefs-miniappview) | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`
- `CidMismatch`: The record changed: review its current version.

## net.krao.phone

<a id="netkraophonedefs"></a>

<a id="netkraophonedefs-status"></a>

### `net.krao.phone.defs#status`

Type: **object**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `verified` | boolean | yes |  |
| `available` | boolean |  | Whether codes can be sent (an SMS provider is set up). |
| `verifiedAt` | string (datetime) |  |  |
| `maskedPhone` | string |  | The verified number with most digits hidden, eg +84******678. |

<a id="netkraophonegetstatus"></a>

### `net.krao.phone.getStatus`

Type: **query**

Whether the viewer has a verified phone number. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.phone.defs#status`](#netkraophonedefs-status)

<a id="netkraophonerequestcode"></a>

### `net.krao.phone.requestCode`

Type: **procedure**

Send a one-time code by SMS to verify the viewer's phone number. A number can belong to one account only; a number another account holds gets the same answer but no SMS, and verifyCode reports PhoneTaken. Every request counts against the rate limits. Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | string | yes | In E.164 form (+84912345678). Vietnamese numbers may also be written 0912345678. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expiresAt` | string (datetime) | yes | When the code stops working. |

**Errors**

- `InvalidPhone`: Not a phone number in E.164 form.
- `PhoneNotSupported`: Numbers of this country cannot be verified here.
- `PhoneUnavailable`: Phone verification is not set up on this service.
- `SmsFailed`: The SMS could not be sent; try again later.

<a id="netkraophoneverifycode"></a>

### `net.krao.phone.verifyCode`

Type: **procedure**

Check the code sent by net.krao.phone.requestCode. On success the number is the viewer's verified phone (replacing an earlier one). Requires service auth for the rewards service.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `phone` | string | yes | The number the code was sent to. |
| `code` | string | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.phone.defs#status`](#netkraophonedefs-status)

**Errors**

- `InvalidPhone`: Not a phone number in E.164 form.
- `PhoneNotSupported`: Numbers of this country cannot be verified here.
- `InvalidCode`: The code is wrong.
- `CodeExpired`: No code is waiting for this number, or it expired.
- `TooManyAttempts`: Too many wrong codes: ask for a new one.
- `PhoneTaken`: Another account verified this number.
- `PhoneUnavailable`: Phone verification is not set up on this service.

<a id="netkraopollpoll"></a>

### `net.krao.poll.poll`

Type: **record** (record key: `any`)

A poll attached to a post. Use the post's record key as this record's key. Polls cannot be changed once indexed: delete and post again. Votes are public records.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `post` | `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` | yes | The post the poll belongs to, in the same repo. |
| `question` | string (≤ 300 graphemes) |  |  |
| `options` | string (≤ 80 graphemes)[] | yes |  |
| `endsAt` | string (datetime) | yes | At most 30 days after the poll is published. |
| `mode` | string (`account`, `verified`, `token`) | yes | 'account': one vote per account; 'verified': one vote per account that verified a phone number or passed KYC; 'token': each vote weighs the voter's balance of the asset at the snapshot block (the latest block when the indexer first saw the poll), summed over the voter's linked wallets. |
| `asset` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#assetId`](#netkraochaindefs-assetid) |  | For 'token' polls: the token (on a chain Krao indexes). |
| `resultsVisibility` | string (`always`, `afterEnd`) |  | 'always' (default) or 'afterEnd': counts are hidden until the poll ends. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

A vote in a poll. Public, like every record. Only the voter's first valid vote counts; votes cannot be changed, and a deleted vote stops counting without freeing a new one.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `poll` | `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` | yes |  |
| `option` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 3) | yes | Index of the chosen option. |
| `createdAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

<a id="netkraorewardsadminreviewkyc"></a>

### `net.krao.rewards.admin.reviewKyc`

Type: **procedure**

Approve or reject an account's KYC by hand. For exceptional cases only: needs a reason and a note, counts against a daily limit, may need a second reviewer, and is logged. Admins only (service auth from a DID in the service's admin list).

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `did` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `decision` | string (`approve`, `reject`) | yes |  |
| `reasonCode` | string (`provider_outage`, `provider_false_reject`, `unsupported_document`, `partner_verified`, `fraud`, `other`) | yes |  |
| `note` | string | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.rewards.admin.defs#kycRecord`](#netkraorewardsadmindefs-kycrecord)

**Errors**

- `DailyLimitReached`: The daily limit of manual reviews has been reached.
- `SameReviewer`: The second approval must come from another reviewer.
- `SelfReview`: Reviewers cannot review their own account.

| `reversed` | integer (≥ 0) | yes |  |

## net.krao.safety

Block a domain (and with it all its subdomains), or allow it to clear a false positive of the synced list or the built-in entries. An admin entry wins over every other entry; a domain has at most one (block or allow). Logged. Safety admins only; requires service auth for the indexer.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `domain` | string | yes | A domain name, or a URL whose host is used. Internationalized names are stored in punycode. |
| `reason` | string |  |  |
| `mode` | string (`block`, `allow`) |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

Schema: [`net.krao.safety.defs#domainView`](#netkraosafetydefs-domainview)

**Errors**

- `InvalidDomain`: Not a domain name.

<a id="netkraosafetycheckaddresses"></a>

### `net.krao.safety.checkAddresses`

Type: **procedure**

Check EVM addresses against the wallets Krao accounts verified: who owns each one, and which verified wallets of other accounts look like it (same first 4 and last 4 hex characters, a different address), a sign of address poisoning. Public and rate limited.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `addresses` | string[] | yes | 0x-prefixed EVM addresses (any case). |
| `expectedDid` | string (did) |  | The account the caller believes the addresses belong to, eg a tip recipient. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `results` | [`net.krao.safety.defs#addressResult`](#netkraosafetydefs-addressresult)[] | yes | One result per address, in the order given. |

**Errors**

- `InvalidAddress`: An address is not a 0x-prefixed 40 hex character EVM address.

<a id="netkraosafetychecklinks"></a>

### `net.krao.safety.checkLinks`

Type: **procedure**

Check links against Krao's list of phishing and wallet-draining domains (an open list synced by the indexer, plus domains Krao admins add). Public and rate limited.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `urls` | string[] | yes | URLs, or bare hosts. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `results` | [`net.krao.safety.defs#linkResult`](#netkraosafetydefs-linkresult)[] | yes | One result per URL, in the order given. |

## net.krao.server

<a id="netkraoservercreatewalletsession"></a>

### `net.krao.server.createWalletSession`

Type: **procedure**

Sign in with a wallet. The signed challenge from net.krao.server.getWalletChallenge is checked, then a session is created for the account on this PDS that has linked the wallet via net.krao.actor.wallet. Returns the same session shape as com.atproto.server.createSession.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | [`net.krao.chain.defs#accountId`](#netkraochaindefs-accountid) | yes |  |
| `message` | string | yes |  |
| `signature` | string | yes |  |
| `authFactorToken` | string |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accessJwt` | string | yes |  |
| `refreshJwt` | string | yes |  |
| `handle` | string (handle) | yes |  |
| `did` | string (did) | yes |  |
| `didDoc` | unknown |  |  |
| `email` | string |  |  |
| `emailConfirmed` | boolean |  |  |
| `emailAuthFactor` | boolean |  |  |
| `active` | boolean |  |  |
| `status` | string (`takendown`, `suspended`, `deactivated`) |  |  |

**Errors**

- `InvalidSignature`: The signature does not match the account and message.
- `ExpiredChallenge`: The challenge is unknown, already used or expired.
- `WalletNotLinked`: No account on this PDS has linked this wallet.
- `AccountTakedown`
- `AuthFactorTokenRequired`

Get a one-time SIWE/SIWS message for a wallet to sign, used by net.krao.server.createWalletSession. Served by the PDS.

**Output** (`application/json`)

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | string | yes | The exact message the wallet must sign. |
| `expiresAt` | string (datetime) | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `UnsupportedChain`

## net.krao.token

<a id="netkraotokenadminputtoken"></a>

### `net.krao.token.admin.putToken`

Type: **procedure**

Add a Base token to Krao's catalog, or change one (by symbol). Its price is read from a Uniswap v3 pool against USDC or WETH: the given pool, or else the pool of the factory with the most liquidity. The pool and the token's decimals are checked on-chain. Token admins (the indexer's safety admins) only; requires service auth for the indexer.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` | string | yes | Cashtag symbol: a letter, then letters and digits (2-10 characters). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `address` | string | yes | ERC-20 contract on Base. |
| `quote` | string (`USDC`, `WETH`, `usd`) |  | What the pool prices the token in. 'usd': a fixed 1 dollar (USD stablecoins), no pool. |
| `pool` | string |  | Uniswap v3 pool of the token and the quote token. Default: found through the factory. |
| `logo` | string (uri) |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `token` | [`net.krao.token.defs#tokenView`](#netkraotokendefs-tokenview) | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `InvalidToken`: Bad symbol or address, or the contract is not an ERC-20 on Base.
- `NoPool`: No usable pool for the token and the quote token.

<a id="netkraotokenadminremovetoken"></a>

### `net.krao.token.admin.removeToken`

Type: **procedure**

Take a token out of Krao's catalog (seed tokens too: they stay out after a restart). Its price history and cashtag posts are dropped. Token admins only; requires service auth for the indexer.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` | string | yes |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `removed` | boolean | yes |  |

<a id="netkraotokenadminsampleprices"></a>

### `net.krao.token.admin.samplePrices`

Type: **procedure**

Read every catalog price now and add it to the price history, without waiting for the next 5-minute round. Token admins only; requires service auth for the indexer.

**Input** (`application/json`)

_No properties._

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sampled` | integer | yes | Tokens whose price was read. |
| `failed` | integer | yes | Tokens whose pool could not be read. |

<a id="netkraotokendefs"></a>

<a id="netkraotokendefs-tokenview"></a>

### `net.krao.token.defs#tokenView`

Type: **object**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | CAIP-19 asset ID, eg 'eip155:8453/erc20:0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000006'. |
| `symbol` | string | yes | The cashtag symbol without '$', as the catalog spells it (eg 'ETH', 'cbBTC'). Lookups ignore case. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `decimals` | integer (≥ 0, ≤ 36) | yes |  |
| `chain` | string | yes | CAIP-2 chain ID, eg 'eip155:8453' (Base). |
| `address` | string | yes | Token contract address. For ETH, the wrapped ether (WETH) contract its price is read from. |
| `logo` | string (uri) |  |  |
| `priceUsd` | string |  | Last price in US dollars, as a decimal string. Absent until the first price is read. |
| `change24h` | string |  | Price change over the last 24 hours in percent, as a decimal string (eg '-2.35'). Absent without a price from about 24 hours ago. |
| `updatedAt` | string (datetime) |  | When the price was read. |
| `holderFeed` | string (at-uri) |  | The 'holders of this token' feed generator (rkey holders-<symbol in lower case>), when one is published for the indexer. |

<a id="netkraotokengetfeed"></a>

### `net.krao.token.getFeed`

Type: **query**

Posts by Krao accounts that mention a catalog token as a cashtag (eg $ETH, in the text or as a tag facet), newest first. Hydrate them with app.bsky.feed.getPosts.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` | string | yes | The symbol, with or without '$'; case is ignored. |
| `limit` | integer (≥ 1, ≤ 100, default 30) |  |  |
| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feed` | [`net.krao.token.defs#feedItem`](#netkraotokendefs-feeditem)[] | yes |  |
| `cursor` | string |  |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`: No token with this symbol in the catalog.

<a id="netkraotokengetpricehistory"></a>

### `net.krao.token.getPriceHistory`

Type: **query**

Prices of a catalog token over a time range, oldest first. Prices are read every 5 minutes; longer ranges keep the last price of each 30-minute (7d) or 2-hour (30d) bucket.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `symbol` | string | yes | The symbol, with or without '$'; case is ignored. |
| `range` | string (`1d`, `7d`, `30d`) |  |  |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `points` | [`net.krao.token.defs#pricePoint`](#netkraotokendefs-pricepoint)[] | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `NotFound`: No token with this symbol in the catalog.

<a id="netkraowalletinspectsignature"></a>

### `net.krao.wallet.inspectSignature`

Type: **procedure**

Explain a message or EIP-712 typed data before the wallet signs it: permits (EIP-2612, DAI, Permit2) and the approvals they grant, marketplace orders, EIP-7702 authorizations, Krao wallet proofs asked for by another site, with safety warnings. Requires service auth for the indexer; rate limited per account and per IP.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | string | yes | CAIP-2 chain id; only eip155:8453 (Base). |
| `from` | string | yes |  |
| `method` | string (`personal_sign`, `eth_signTypedData_v4`) | yes |  |
| `payload` | string | yes | personal_sign: the message (text, or 0x hex bytes); eth_signTypedData_v4: the typed data as JSON. |
| `origin` | string |  | The https origin of the Mini App asking, if any. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string (`message`, `permit`, `permit2`, `order`, `eip7702Authorization`, `loginProof`, `typedData`) | yes |  |
| `summary` | string |  |  |
| `domain` | [`net.krao.wallet.inspectSignature#domain`](#netkraowalletinspectsignature-domain) |  |  |
| `approvals` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#approval`](#netkraowalletdefs-approval)[] | yes |  |
| `warnings` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#warning`](#netkraowalletdefs-warning)[] | yes |  |

**Errors**

- `UnsupportedChain`
- `InvalidAddress`
- `InvalidPayload`

<a id="netkraowalletinspectsignature-domain"></a>

### `net.krao.wallet.inspectSignature#domain`

Type: **object**

The EIP-712 domain of typed data.

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `chainId` | string |  |  |
| `verifyingContract` | string |  |  |

<a id="netkraowalletsimulate"></a>

### `net.krao.wallet.simulate`

Type: **procedure**

Preview a transaction before the wallet signs it: run it on Krao's node (debug_traceCall with callTracer) to list what the signer would lose and receive and which approvals it grants, with safety warnings. When the node cannot trace, the calldata is only decoded ('decode'). Base only. Requires service auth for the indexer; rate limited per account and per IP.

**Input** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `chain` | string | yes | CAIP-2 chain id; only eip155:8453 (Base). |
| `from` | string | yes |  |
| `to` | string | yes |  |
| `data` | string |  | 0x-prefixed calldata. |
| `value` | string |  | Native value in wei, decimal (0x hex is accepted too). |
| `authorizationList` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#authorization`](#netkraowalletdefs-authorization)[] |  | EIP-7702 authorizations sent with the transaction. |
| `origin` | string |  | The https origin of the Mini App asking, if any. |

**Output** (`application/json`)

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ok` | boolean | yes | False when the transaction reverts or the node could not run it. |
| `revertReason` | string |  |  |
| `method` | string (`trace`, `decode`) | yes |  |
| `changes` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#balanceChange`](#netkraowalletdefs-balancechange)[] | yes |  |
| `approvals` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#approval`](#netkraowalletdefs-approval)[] | yes |  |
| `warnings` | [`net.krao.wallet.defs#warning`](#netkraowalletdefs-warning)[] | yes |  |
| `gasEstimate` | string |  | Gas, decimal. |
| `usdOut` | string |  | What the outgoing assets are worth in US dollars at the catalog's prices, when known. |

**Errors**

- `UnsupportedChain`
- `InvalidAddress`
